BM-01.label: Vertical AI SaaS
BM-01.definition: Software for a specific industry workflow; AI is core to the product

BM-02.label: Horizontal AI SaaS
BM-02.definition: Cross-industry workflow software sold on recurring seats or subscriptions

BM-03.label: AI devtools / infrastructure
BM-03.definition: Sells to builders: APIs, runtimes, observability, sandboxes, agent infra

BM-04.label: AI labor / managed service
BM-04.definition: Outcome or team replacement; services-shaped delivery (ops, consulting, compliance)

BM-05.label: Fintech / insurance product
BM-05.definition: Regulated financial product: payments, lending, insurance, wallets, risk

BM-06.label: Data / intelligence product
BM-06.definition: Research, terminals, analytics feeds, enrichment — data is the product

BM-07.label: Marketplace / network
BM-07.definition: Two-sided matching, liquidity, or coordination between parties

BM-08.label: Hardware + software
BM-08.definition: Physical systems (robotics, drones, sensors) with embedded intelligence

BM-09.label: Biotech / R&D platform
BM-09.definition: Science, trials, lab, or biopharma R&D workflows — not classic SaaS

BM-10.label: Consumer app / prosumer
BM-10.definition: End-user subscription, usage, or consumer-facing application

BM-11.label: Defense / gov-critical infrastructure
BM-11.definition: Supply chain, sensing, or systems for government or defense customers

BM-12.label: Open source + commercial
BM-12.definition: Open-source core with hosted, enterprise, or support monetization
